<a id="commands"></a>

## Commands

_No entries._

<a id="done-when"></a>

## Done when

The repo validates and checks procedures, ignores run progress, and has a first procedure that passes the drift check. Running every step again changes nothing.

<a id="known-limits"></a>

## Known limits

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| l-1 | It adds recipes to the root justfile only when that file has no `proc` recipe; a repo with its own `proc` keeps it. |
| l-2 | The repo still needs `ddocs` and `pij` on PATH; this procedure does not install them. |

<a id="mistakes"></a>

## Mistakes

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| m-1 | Running it from the pij skill's folder instead of the target repo: every step works on the repo you run it from. |
